Marionette is done by Malk Impersonated Blanche at the end of the predator's
turn with the Madness Network in play? The affected vampire can't act until

will have that stolen vamp during his/her untap phase and can use the Towers

text on the Spirit Marionette

+1 stealth action. (D) Take control of any ready untapped minion UNTIL THE
END OF THE NEXT ACTION. That minion must bleed your prey unless he or she
must hunt.

Is this the intent of the poster?

IANLSJ but i pretty sure it does work (i believe this concept had been
discussed on the ng a few months ago). Using the now-Malkavian Blanche
to Spirit Marionette one of your predator's vamp at the end of HIS
minion phase (via Madness Network) means that unless the stolen vamp
is malkavian, he can't bleed and no other action is performed. Hence
the Marionette stays controlled by you until it can legally bleed
which will be during your own minion phase. With a full untap phase in
between, i do believe that's enough time to send the hapless vamp for
a one-way trip to the Towers :)

TPOTH Koldun

Almost correct. The stolen Marionette stays controlled by you until some
action is taken (not necessarily until "it can legally bleed").

The "combo" will fall apart if any other Malk takes an action after the
Spirit Marrionette action, since the Marionnetted vampire will then
be returned at the end of that action, for example.

Barring any additional Networked actions, however, the Marionetted vampire
will still be under your control when you reach your untap phase (unless,
of course, the player whose turn it is contests it by bringing out another
copy during her influence phase first. :-)
